### 2026-10-10 – # Onshape CAD and FRC Robotics

**12.08h**

# Onshape CAD and FRC Robotics

This week I spent about 2 hours a day (Mon-Fri) going through Onshape tutorials and applying what I learned to FRC-related CAD work.

I also worked on Starbie and It’s helped me get more comfortable with CAD and PCB design, skills I want to develop further for robotics. I want to learn how to integrate an Orange Pi on our robot for computer vision and camera calibration especially.

My long term goal is to be able to design an entire FRC robot in onshape and bring it to life through code. It’s been a good way to develop the skills I need to work toward that goal, while also learning more about how mechanical design, electronics and programming fit together in a whole robot.
